What is the domain of the parameter $t?$

feedback.worked_solution:
The parametric equations of the full hyperbola are

$$
x=3\operatorname{sec}⁡t,\,y=\sqrt{5}\operatorname{tan}⁡t,\,t\in [-\pi ,\pi ],\,t\ne \pm \frac{\pi }{2}.
$$

To restrict the parameterization to a single branch, we refer to the diagram below.

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture/14053984/assets/e03130cdcae3fff94036453883eb638371b62a4ee26b9b550192aed32f95a39d.png)

We can see that if we restrict $t$ to $[-\pi ,-\frac{\pi }{2})$ and $(\frac{\pi }{2},\pi ],$ we get only the left branch.

Therefore, the parametric equations that describe only the left branch are

$$
x=3\operatorname{sec}⁡t,\,y=\sqrt{5}\operatorname{tan}⁡t,\,t\in [-\pi ,-\frac{\pi }{2})\text{ }\cup \text{ }(\frac{\pi }{2},\pi ].
$$
